title: [POWERFUL 🔥] COMMAND YOUR DAY IN TOTAL VICTORY BY DECLARING THESE POWERFUL PRAYER
text: Get up. Get up from that bed right now. Don't reach for your phone. Don't scroll. Don't check messages. Put your feet on the floor and open your mouth. The sun hasn't fully come up yet. And before it does, somebody has to take charge of this day. Will it be you or the enemy? I said, will it be you or the enemy? Then open your mouth and shout, "This morning belongs to God and this morning belongs to me." Shout it again. This morning belongs to God and this morning belongs to me. Father, we have come early. [music] We have come before the noise. We have come before the traffic, before the market opens, before the office calls, before the enemy finishes his plans. We have come to the gate of the morning and we are not living empty-handed in the name of Jesus. Listen to me. In Job 38:12-13, God asks Job, "Have you commanded the morning since your days and cause the daypring to know his place that it might take hold of the ends of the earth that the wicked might be shaken out of it?" Do you hear that? The morning has ends, and those ends can be grabbed and shaken. And when they are shaken, the wicked fall out. Every morning the day comes waiting for instructions. If you don't give it instructions, somebody else will. Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord, in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up." Direct it this morning. Aim it like an arrow. Let's go. Lift both hands right now and pray like this. [music] Father, in the name of Jesus, I take hold of the ends of this morning. I take hold of the corners of this day. Every wicked thing hiding inside this day, I shake you out now. Shake it. Grab the edges of this day and shake it. Every evil arrangement scheduled [music] for this day, fall out. Every bad news scheduled for 12:00 noon, fall out. Every accident planned on that road, fall out. Every quarrel planned for my house this evening, fall out. Every disappointment programmed into this day, I SHAKE YOU OUT BY FIRE. EVERY WICKED HAND HIDDEN INSIDE MY MORNING, CATCH FIRE AND COME OUT. MORNING, hear me. Morning of this day, I speak to you in the name of Jesus. You will not cooperate with my enemies. You will not carry their messages. You will not deliver their arrows. Sun that rises today, you will not smite me by day. Moon that rises tonight, you will not smite me by night. Psalm 121 is my covenant. And the keeper of Israel does not slumber. Somebody just took hold of the morning. I can feel it. Somebody's day just changed direction. Something that was waiting for you at the junction this afternoon has just been removed. Shout, "Thank you, Jesus." Now, open your mouth again. Exodus 14:4 says that in the morning, watch, the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the [music] pillar of fire and of the cloud and troubled the host of the Egyptians. In the morning, watch God looks at your enemies. And when [music] he looks, they get troubled. Pray this way. Lord, look at my enemies this morning through the pillar of fire. Pillar of fire arise. Look at the camp of my pursuers. Every pharaoh pursuing my destiny be troubled this morning. Every Egyptian army chasing my progress. Your chariot wheels come off. Every enemy that says we will overtake, we will divide the spoil. Drown in your own Red Sea this morning. Every pursuer behind me, the waters are coming back over you now. [clears throat] You will see them today, but you will see them no more forever. I decree the enemy that was pursuing you yesterday will not see you today. I decree the battle you have fought for 10 years ends this morning. I decree the God of the morning watch has looked through the fire and your enemies are confused. Receive it. Now we're going to deal with chains. Put your hand on your neck and say, "Every yoke on my neck." Hear the word of the Lord. Isaiah 10:27 says, "The burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and the yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing." It doesn't say the yoke will be adjusted. It doesn't say it will be loosened a little. It says destroyed. Pray now. Pray with violence. Every yoke of limitation on my neck be destroyed by the anointing. Yoke of slow progress, [music] break. Yoke of almost there, break. Yoke of laboring without harvest. Break. Yoke of running fast and staying in the [music] same place. Break. Yoke that my father carried and handed to me, I refuse to carry you. Break. Yoke that my mother wore and wept under. You will not sit on my neck. Break. Yoke of borrowing. Yoke of begging. Yoke of shame. Break. Break. Break. Chain of delay. I'm talking to you. Chain wrapped around my leg so I cannot move forward. Snap. Chain tying my hands so I cannot walk and prosper. Snap. [music] Chain on my mouth so that when I speak nobody listens. Snap. Chain on my mind so I keep forgetting what God told me. Snap. Every invisible rope holding me down while my mates are rising be caught by the sword of the spirit. Isaiah 49 24- 26. Shall the prey be taken from the mighty or the lawful captive delivered? But thus said the Lord, even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered. For I will contend with him [music] that contendeth with thee. Somebody, it's your turn to be delivered this morning. God says, I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh. Pray this way. Lord, contend with those who contend with me this morning. Every [music] strong man holding my portion as prey, release it now. Every terrible power keeping my destiny in captivity, let go. [snorts] Mighty one sitting on my blessing, I don't care how mighty you are, my God is mightier. Get up and release it. Every oppressor of my life, eat your own flesh. Drink your [music] own blood. Let all flesh know that the Lord is my savior and my redeemer, the mighty one of Jacob. There is a man here. I see you sitting at the edge of your bed with your head in your hands. You've been carrying a weight in your chest for 3 years. I hear the Lord say that chain has been cut this morning. Stand up. Stand up and breathe. Breathe deep. Somebody's chest just opened. It's done. Now altars. Every morning before you wake up, somebody somewhere may already have spoken your name over an altar. Don't panic. Don't be afraid. Fight back. In the early morning, God's answer is fire. Elijah prepared the sacrifice at the time of the evening offering and the fire fell. Today, we are calling that same fire into the morning. Open your mouth and declare every [music] altar raised against my life. Catch fire. Altar in my father's village where my name is being called, catch [music] fire. Altar under that tree, altar in that river, altar in that shrine, altar in that compound, catch fire. Every priest [music] ministering at an altar against my destiny be silenced. Every incantation spoken against me before dawn, return to sender. Every candle lit to monitor my life be blown out. Every mirror they are using to watch my movement shatter. Every pot they are staring against my health break into pieces. Altar of untimely death, catch fire. Altar of marital failure, catch fire. Altar of poverty that every child of my family must bow to, I will not bow, catch fire. Altar of sickness that has been eating our family from generation to generation. It ends with me to catch fire. Altar of shame, altar of reproach, altar of they will be useful to everyone but themselves be roasted to ashes. Every sacrifice that was offered for my sake, sacrifice of blood, sacrifice of animals, sacrifice of things I don't even know about, I nullify you by the blood of Jesus. The blood of goats and bulls cannot overpower the blood of the lamb. Hebrews says the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Blood of Jesus, speak for me this morning. Speak louder than every altar. Speak louder than every curse. [music] speak louder than every accusation. Now hear this. Colossians 2:14-15 says, "He blotted out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and [music] took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross, and having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it." There is handwriting against some of us. Some documents were signed in the spirit [music] before you were born. A grandmother made a deal. A great-grandfather entered into a covenant. Your name was written in the agreement, [music] but somebody wrote over it in blood. Put your hand on your head and pray. Every handwriting written against me be blotted out by the blood of Jesus. Every covenant I did not sign, but I am paying for be cancelled. Every agreement my ancestors made with darkness, I withdraw my name. I withdraw my children's names, I withdraw my destiny. Every dedication of my life to any idol, any river, any spirit, any diety, I renounce you this morning and I reject you by the cross of Calvary. Every oath that was sworn over my birth be nullified. Every name I was given that is connecting me to a demonic covenant, I break that connection now. Galatians 3:13, Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a cause for us. For it is written, cursed is everyone that hangeth on [music] a tree. Jesus hung on the tree so that the cost would not hang on me. Generational cause. Hear me, [music] you stop at my door, you will not enter my generation. Cause of late marriage that took [music] my aunties, you stop here. Cause of dying at 40 that took my uncles, you stop here. Cause of mad people in my lineage, you stop here. Cause of divorce that ran through my family like a river, you dry up here. Cause of hard labor without reward, you are broken this morning. I decree from this morning, I am the beginning of a new lineage. I decree my children will not inherit the battles I fought. I decree the evil pattern in my family has met a wall. It cannot pass. [music] And that wall is the cross of Jesus Christ. It is finished. Shout, "It is finished." >> Again, it is finished. Somebody's grandmother's covenant just broke. Somebody, I hear the Lord say, "It was connected to water. It was connected to a river near your hometown." That connection is dissolving right now. As we pray, you will feel lighter from today. Let me take you somewhere else now. The household. Micah 7:6 says, "A man's enemies are the men of his own house." Jesus repeated it in Matthew 10. [music] We are not praying against people. We are praying against the spirits using people. Some of you sleep under the same roof as the arrow. Some of you eat from the same pot as the monitor. We don't hate anybody. But this morning, every spirit walking through the household is going to be exposed. Open your mouth and pray. Every household wickedness assigned against my life be exposed [music] and disgraced this morning. Every power in my family that rejoices when I fall [music] be disappointed. Everyone who smiles in my face and fights me in the dream, let your mask fall off. Every household witch that has been feeding on my star, formit it now. Every family power that has vowed, I will not go beyond where they stopped. Your vow is broken. Every [music] power in my father's house that is jealous of my rising be silenced forever. I break every [music] monitoring connection between my life and the evil eye of the household. Every spirit following my movements, reporting my plans, I blind you by the light of God. Every time I make a plan, somebody knows it and blocks it. Not again. Every listening ear in the spirit planted in my house go deaf. Every evil bird watching my house fall down and die. Every dark observer sitting at the gate of my compound be scattered by the east wind. Psalm 68:1. Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered, let them also that hate him flee before him. As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God. Let God arise in my house. Let God arise in my bedroom. Let God arise in my kitchen. Let God arise in my car. Let God arise in my office. Let God arise and every enemy scatter like smoke. Every wicked power melt like wax. Now, I want you to pray specifically about the dream. Some of you have been fed in the dream. Some of you have been married in the dream. Some of you have been pursued in the dream. [music] Some of you wake up tired like you worked all night. That's not your portion. Pray this way. Every night operation against my life, I cancel you this morning. Every food I ate in the dream be flushed out by the blood of Jesus. Every spiritual husband, every spiritual wife, I divorce you this morning. I return your ring. I tear your certificate. I reject your covenant. Go. Every masquerade chasing me in the dream be arrested. Every snake I saw in my sleep be crushed under my heel. Every dream of going back to school, going back to the village, going back to old houses, every dream OF BACKWARDNESS, I CANCEL YOU. I will not go back. I will go forward. Psalm 91:5-6. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday. I am not afraid of the night anymore. I am not afraid of the noonday anymore. I am covered from midnight to midday and from midday to midnight. [music] There's a woman here. You have been waking up at 3:00 in the morning. Every night, the same time, something has been pressing you down on the bed. The Lord says that visitation is over. [music] From tonight you will sleep and wake up refreshed. Receive it now. Let's change gear. Lift your hands. Obadiah 1:17 says, "But upon Mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness, and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions." Deliverance is not the end. Possession is the end. You can be delivered and still be empty. This morning we are going to possess. Pray this way. Father, everything the enemy stole from me, I recover it this morning. [music] I recover my stolen glory. I recover my stolen star. I recover my stolen opportunities. The job that was given to someone else because they manipulated my name, I recover the reward of it. The contract that disappeared at the last minute, I recover what he should have brought. [music] The marriage proposal that was scattered by evil hands, I recover my joy. The money that entered my hands and vanish like water, I recover it sevenfold. Every bank of darkness holding my destiny, open your doors. Every warehouse where my blessings are stored, I break the lock. Every evil custodian holding my file, hand it over. Every strong man sitting on my inheritance, I bind you by the authority of Matthew 16:1 19. Whatsoever I bind on earth is bound in heaven, and whatsoever I lose on earth is loosed in heaven. I bind you, strong man, and I lose my blessings. Pursue, overtake, recover all. Like David at Ziglag, I pursue, I overtake, I recover all. Nothing missing, nothing broken, nothing lacking, not small, not great, not sons, not daughters, not spoiled. David recovered all and I recover all. Somebody's star is shining again this morning. Somebody, you used to be known. You used to be respected. People used to call your name with honor. Something happened and you became invisible. I hear the Lord saying, "Your name [music] is coming back. They will look for you again. They will call you again. Shout, "My glory is restored." Isaiah 60:1, "Arise, shine, for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee. [music] The glory rose upon you like the morning sun. It's morning. The light has come. I decree that from this morning you will be seen. You will be found. You will be chosen. You will be celebrated. Now hold on. Let's breathe just for a moment. Lamentations 3:22-23. Whatever happened yesterday, there's new mercy this morning. Yesterday's failure has no jurisdiction over today's mercy. So receive it. Say, Lord, I receive new mercy this morning. Mercy that cancels judgment, locate me. Mercy that overrules the accuser, speak for me. Every place where my mistakes have opened a door to the enemy, MERCY SHUT THAT DOOR. Every season I wasted in sin and foolishness, mercy redeem it. [music] Every bad decision that brought me to this place, mercy rewrite the ending. I am not consumed. I am still standing.
